mapper.update: /**cmnty-mapper.updateMaintenanceInqCnt */ UPDATE G_SR_MAINTENANCE SET INQ_CNT = INQ_CNT + 1 WHERE BBS_ID = #{bbsId}
mapper.select: /**cmnty-mapper.getMaintenanceDetail */ SELECT A.BBS_ID , A.KI_TYPE , A.sr_no , date_format(str_to_date(req_crt_date, '%Y%m%d'), '%Y-%m-%d') as req_crt_date , req_dt , req_user_phone_number AS req_user_phone_number , req_channel , req_type , process_type , A.BBS_TTL , A.BBS_CN , A.req_user_info AS req_user_info , A.urgent_yn , A.req_source , A.process_manager_id , A.process_manager_nm AS process_manager_nm , A.process_cn , A.process_receipt_date , A.process_target_end_date , A.process_start_date , A.process_end_date , A.process_state , A.rm , (SELECT ATCH_FILE_SZ FROM G_SR_MAINTENANCE_FILE WHERE BBS_ID = A.BBS_ID AND USE_YN = 'Y') as ATCH_FILE_SZ , B.USER_NAME AS req_manager_nm , C.LOCGOV_NM , C.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM , A.USE_YN , A.FRST_CRT_ID , A.FRST_CRT_DT , A.LAST_MDFCN_ID , A.LAST_MDFCN_DT , (SELECT MIN(AUTHORITY) FROM OP_USER_ROLE WHERE USER_ID = A.FRST_CRT_ID) AS AUTHORITY , A.INQ_CNT FROM G_SR_MAINTENANCE A LEFT JOIN OP_MANAGER B ON A.FRST_CRT_ID = B.USER_ID LEFT JOIN G_LOCGOV C ON B.LOCGOV_CODE = C.LOCGOV_CODE WHERE A.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'

/**cmnty-mapper.getMaintenancefileList */ SELECT FILE_ID , BBS_ID , ORGNL_ATCH_FILE_NM , ATCH_FILE_NM , ATCH_FILE_EXTN_NM , ATCH_FILE_SZ , ATCH_FILE_SEQ , ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM G_SR_MAINTENANCE_FILE WHERE BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/**cmnty-mapper.getMaintenanceFileDetail */ SELECT FILE_ID , BBS_ID , ORGNL_ATCH_FILE_NM , ATCH_FILE_NM , ATCH_FILE_EXTN_NM , ATCH_FILE_SZ , ATCH_FILE_SEQ , ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM G_SR_MAINTENANCE_FILE WHERE FILE_ID = #{fileId}
